sources.name: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
sources.license_note: Review NOAA/NWS data notices; preserve attribution and disclaimer.
sources.limits_note: No fixed quota verified in this registry; use conservative caching.
sources.use_note: Contextual GNSS quality correlation only; not evidence of intentional interference.

sources.name: Uppsala Conflict Data Program Georeferenced Event Dataset
sources.limits_note: API quota documented as 5,000 requests/day; token requested from maintainer. Downloads are free.
sources.use_note: Versioned historical/event context; show codebook definitions and publication lag.
sources.license_note: CC BY 4.0 for the GED download; retain UCDP attribution and cite the dataset version/codebook. Confirm API-specific terms separately.

sources.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem STAC
sources.license_note: Check collection-specific Copernicus terms and any contributing-mission conditions.
sources.limits_note: Published free-tier quotas vary by API; consult live quota documentation.
sources.use_note: Metadata discovery first; user-requested retrospective comparisons, not real-time tactical monitoring.

sources.name: OpenAQ API v3
sources.license_note: OpenAQ attribution required; check each underlying provider's licence and terms.
sources.limits_note: Free general-use key: 60 requests/minute and 2,000 requests/hour.
sources.use_note: Environmental context only; air-quality readings do not attribute cause.

sources.name: Global Fishing Watch APIs
sources.limits_note: Terms currently state up to 50,000 requests/day and 1,500,000/month.
sources.use_note: Non-commercial only; use retrospective/aggregated context. Not comprehensive vessel coverage and not a military-vessel tracker.

sources.name: ACLED
sources.license_note: Confirm current user eligibility, API plan, redistribution and commercial terms before implementation.
sources.limits_note: No free quota asserted here.
sources.use_note: Cross-check event reporting; keep ACLED classifications separate from analyst conclusions.

sources.name: ReliefWeb API
sources.license_note: Respect API terms and the rights of original report publishers.
sources.limits_note: Approved appname required; confirm current usage limits.
sources.use_note: Humanitarian context and retrospective reporting, not a live sensor feed.

sources.name: Global Energy Monitor open datasets
sources.license_note: Review the licence and attribution for each dataset individually before bundling or redistributing; do not assume one licence covers all datasets.
sources.limits_note: Download-based datasets; no live API or polling quota asserted.
sources.use_note: Static/periodic infrastructure baseline and retrospective context only; not evidence of current operational activity.

sources.name: OpenSanctions
sources.license_note: Hosted API terms and underlying dataset rights apply; confirm public-interest eligibility and current terms before use.
sources.limits_note: Not an unlimited free API; API usage is metered for paid plans. Entity and statements endpoints may have different billing treatment.
sources.use_note: Analyst-initiated entity research only; never infer identity from name similarity or automatically screen people found in live observations.

sources.name: Copernicus Emergency Management Service Mapping API
sources.license_note: Public products are freely viewable/downloadable; verify activation restrictions and product-specific attribution before reuse. Some activations are sensitive/restricted.
sources.limits_note: No general request quota asserted; use bounded pagination and conservative caching.
sources.use_note: Retrospective emergency/event context only; not a military activity feed or tactical monitoring service.

sources.name: EUMETSAT Data Store and EUMETView
sources.license_note: Check licence and redistribution terms for each product collection; preserve platform/product attribution.
sources.limits_note: Data Store throttling and access limits apply; published FAQ lists a maximum of 30 requests/second, 5 TB/day and 10 parallel connections.
sources.use_note: Meteorological/environmental context and retrospective analysis; product latency and coverage vary by collection.

sources.name: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database (with World Bank WDI access path)
sources.license_note: SIPRI data may be freely downloaded and cited for statistical/analytical use under its fair-use policy; reproduction and commercial use are restricted and may require permission. World Bank API delivery does not remove SIPRI's underlying terms. Attribute SIPRI.
sources.limits_note: Annual downloadable workbook; World Bank Indicators API v2 is keyless and paginated. Pin the exact workbook revision and API retrieval date.
sources.use_note: Annual country-level strategic trend context only. The World Bank indicator is derived from SIPRI and is not an independent corroborating source. Expenditure is an input measure, not a direct measure of capability or operational activity.

sources.name: SIPRI Arms Transfers Database
sources.license_note: SIPRI retains copyright; use must be non-commercial and within its fair-use policy unless separately licensed. Attribute SIPRI and review terms before redistribution.
sources.limits_note: Public database supports CSV export; updated annually. Pin the dataset release and query/export parameters.
sources.use_note: Historical, country-level and multi-year transfer trends only. SIPRI TIV measures volume of military resources, not financial value or exact deal price; do not infer current deployment or operational intent.

sources.name: NATO Defence Expenditure Reports
sources.license_note: Review NATO publication and table reuse terms; preserve attribution. Figures use NATO's agreed definition and should not be silently merged with SIPRI estimates.
sources.limits_note: Annual PDF/Excel report; the 2014-2025 edition states a 3 June 2025 information cut-off and estimates for 2024/2025.
sources.use_note: Annual aggregate trend context for NATO members, not live activity. Explicitly label estimates, reference date and methodology; compare with SIPRI only as separate series.

sources.name: United Nations Register of Conventional Arms (UNROCA)
sources.license_note: Use publicly accessible UN Member State submissions and UN Digital Library reports with source attribution; verify reuse terms for each document and data extract.
sources.limits_note: Annual voluntary state reporting; coverage, completeness and reporting years vary. Some states submit nil returns; absence of a report is not evidence of no transfers. No stable public API verified.
sources.use_note: Country-year transparency context and reported transfers only. Distinguish actual transfers from authorizations where a state report says so. Preserve reporting state, year, nil-return status, category and source document. Not a real-time feed.

sources.name: UN Comtrade HS Chapter 93 trade statistics
sources.license_note: UN Comtrade data use is governed by UN Comtrade fair-use policy and applicable source attribution. Free preview is public; expanded API access requires a registered account and key. Keep API keys server-side.
sources.limits_note: Keyless preview is limited to 500 records. Current free registered subscription advertises 500 API calls/day, 1 call/second and up to 100,000 records per call; verify current limits before implementation.
sources.use_note: HS Chapter 93 is a broad customs classification for arms and ammunition, not a complete inventory of military equipment or verified arms deliveries. Reported trade statistics may be delayed, revised, asymmetric or missing; do not infer operational deployment or intent.

sources.name: European Defence Agency Defence Data
sources.license_note: Review reuse terms for each annual report and downloadable table; preserve EDA attribution. Keep EDA's member-state definitions separate from SIPRI and NATO series.
sources.limits_note: Annual data collected and compiled by EDA since 2006, with some indicators since 2005. Dataset years and indicator availability vary.
sources.use_note: Historical and annual European defence trend context only. Not a live activity feed. Do not combine series without documenting coverage, definitions, currency, fiscal-year and estimate differences.

sources.name: SIPRI National Budget Archive
sources.license_note: Archive links to government and institutional documents; assess reuse rights at the original publisher for each document. Cite SIPRI's archive as discovery provenance and the original publisher as the document source.
sources.limits_note: Documents available depend on country and year; the archive is updated annually from 2021 data onwards. Links and availability may change.
sources.use_note: Use to trace and audit the primary documents underlying military-expenditure estimates. This is documentary evidence, not a standardized expenditure time series and not independent of SIPRI when the document is already a SIPRI input.

sources.name: Global Disaster Awareness and Coordination System
sources.license_note: GDACS requests source acknowledgement as Global Disaster Awareness and Coordination System, GDACS; review current disclaimer and terms before reuse.
sources.limits_note: No stable public quota verified in this review; implement conservative caching, bounded date windows and pagination.
sources.use_note: Multi-hazard alert and event context. Alert levels are GDACS classifications, not ground-truth severity or confirmation; preserve event type, alert level, issue time, geometry and source link.

sources.name: NASA Fire Information for Resource Management System
sources.license_note: Follow NASA Earthdata/FIRMS data-use guidance and preserve source, sensor and product attribution; verify product-specific conditions.
sources.limits_note: Free MAP_KEY required. Published limit is 5,000 transactions per 10-minute interval; large requests can count as multiple transactions. Product availability and latency vary by sensor and processing stream.
sources.use_note: Satellite thermal anomaly detections are not proof of a confirmed fire, cause or intent. Preserve acquisition time in UTC, sensor/platform, product/version, confidence scale and FRP; do not compare MODIS numeric confidence directly with VIIRS categorical confidence.

sources.name: ESA Database and Information System Characterising Objects in Space
sources.license_note: Registration and acceptance of DISCOSweb terms required; derived works and redistributions must include ESA's prescribed source acknowledgement.
sources.limits_note: API version and access terms must be checked at implementation time; do not assume anonymous access.
sources.use_note: Static/catalogue metadata for trackable unclassified objects; not live tracking and does not distribute surveillance-derived orbital or attitude ephemerides. Complement, do not replace, public TLE/ephemeris sources.
